result.title: Meet Brian and Beast, the dots at work at Holiday Extras
result.description:
David Lee, Director of Innovation & Growth at Holiday Extras, calls his dot, Brian, on his morning commute. They talk through the meetings ahead, and Brian can have a report ready by the time David gets to his desk. His colleague Liam Thompson, VP of AI Innovation, calls his dot Beast. The day after Holiday Extras launched a new app feature, Beast checked how it was performing and brought Liam the numbers before he’d even asked. 

Get to know David, Liam and their dots in the Holiday Extras story:  https://openai.com/business/customer-stories/holiday-extras-dots/

result.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Accounting
result.description:
ChatGPT for Accounting helps take the busywork out of your month-end close.

Watch how ChatGPT finds completed jobs in your email and drafts QuickBooks invoices for your review, flagging anything unclear along the way.

The Accounting plugin also helps you reconcile transactions, process invoices and receipts, and prepare monthly reports using your existing spreadsheets and connected accounting tools.

Learn more about the plugins: 
https://openai.com/business/solutions/accounting

result.title: An underrated way to use ChatGPT: Life admin
result.description:
Even ChatGPT researchers need a little help with life admin.

Isa F. shares an underrated way she uses ChatGPT: keeping track of the details and making time for her next haircut.

result.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Sales
result.description:
Spend less time on busywork and more time selling with ChatGPT for Sales.

The new Sales plugin and 30+ new and expanded partner plugins bring your customer context and sales tools together in ChatGPT. Prepare for calls, tailor proposals, and follow up faster with insights from the tools your team already uses.

Learn more: https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-for-sales/

result.title: Building 3D video sets with GPT-6.2 Astra
result.description:
GPT-6.2 Astra is our new flagship model, delivering a step up in capability with cleaner code, better frontends and 3D models, and more efficient tool use.

Recreate a room from just two video frames with GPT-6.2 Astra in Codex. See how it builds the set in Blender, changes the decor and lighting, and turns the scene into an interactive space and a virtual webcam background.
